tools.name: ssh_server_info
tools.description: Show current SSH server connection info and the remote project root (remoteRoot). Call this first when you start working or when unsure about the remote configuration. No arguments.

tools.name: ssh_write_file
tools.description: Write (overwrite) a file on the remote SSH server. Use this for ALL backend files instead of local editing. path is relative to remoteRoot (e.g. "backend/src/server.js"). Parent directories are created automatically. NEVER create backend files locally on Windows.

path.description: Relative path from remoteRoot, e.g. backend/src/server.js

tools.name: ssh_read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the remote SSH server. path is relative to remoteRoot (e.g. "backend/src/server.js"). Use this to inspect backend code before modifying it. Returns UTF-8 text (truncated if very large).

path.description: Relative path from remoteRoot, e.g. backend/src/server.js

tools.name: ssh_list_dir
tools.description: List a directory on the remote SSH server. path is relative to remoteRoot (empty string or "." lists the root). Returns entries with type (dir/file), size and mtime.

path.description: Relative directory path from remoteRoot, e.g. "backend" or "" for root

tools.name: ssh_mkdir
tools.description: Create directory (and missing parents) on the remote SSH server. path is relative to remoteRoot.

path.description: Relative directory path from remoteRoot, e.g. backend/src

tools.name: ssh_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a file or directory (recursively) on the remote SSH server. path is relative to remoteRoot. Deleting the root itself is forbidden. Use with caution.

path.description: Relative path from remoteRoot of the file/dir to delete

tools.name: ssh_move
tools.description: Move or rename a file/directory on the remote SSH server. Both paths are relative to remoteRoot. Parent directory of destPath is created automatically.

tools.name: ssh_run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command on the remote SSH server. Use this for backend tasks such as: npm install, npm run dev, restart services, check logs, run migrations. cwd is relative to remoteRoot (e.g. "backend"); if omitted, the command runs in remoteRoot (or the login home if remoteRoot is not set). Returns exit code, stdout and stderr. Output is truncated at ~200KB.

command.description: The shell command to run, e.g. "npm install" or "node server.js &"

cwd.description: Relative working directory from remoteRoot, e.g. "backend"
